# Security policy

## Supported version

Security fixes are applied to the latest revision of `main`, which is the only
supported version of this portfolio.

## Reporting a vulnerability

Please do not open a public issue for a suspected vulnerability or exposed
credential. Use GitHub's **Report a vulnerability** private reporting flow in
the Security tab of this repository.

Include the affected route or component, a concise reproduction, potential
impact, and any suggested mitigation. Do not access data that does not belong
to you, degrade the service, or publish secrets or personal information.

Reports will be acknowledged as soon as practical. Confirmed issues are
prioritized by impact and fixed on `main`; details may remain private until a
safe deployment is available.
